newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers ease on lack of enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers ease on lack of enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices eased on Thursday after a lack of orders caused sellers to lower offers, traders said.

Late Wednesday, shipowners were sidelined when sellers raised their offers on firm crude levels and a supportive cargo market, traders said. One trader said "the dearth of orders have forced sellers to lower their offers".
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $102-103 per tonne and 380-cst at $96-97, down about a dollar from Wednesday. MDO and gas oil were quoted around $198-$203 and $210-$215 respectively.
